output.summary: A flowering plant native to humid mountain ranges from southern Europe through the Caucasus and northern Iran, with widely separated populations in Siberia and from the Himalayas east to Korea. In mainland Portugal's 2016–2019 assessment, it occupied wet, nutrient-poor hay meadows in the northeastern highlands and was Endangered, with four identified locations and continuing habitat decline. Abandonment of traditional meadow management and excessive grazing were important threats there.
